lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Spirit of the Lord clothes Gideon. He sounds the trumpet. Thirty-two thousand gather at the spring of Harod.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: The people are too many. I cannot give Midian into their hands, lest Israel boast against Me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return. Twenty-two thousand leave. Ten thousand remain.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: The people are still too many. Bring them to the water, and I will test them there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the water, three hundred lap with their hands to their mouths. All the rest kneel down to drink.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: With the three hundred who lapped I will save you and give the Midianites into your hand.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The point is not alertness or virtue. Israel cannot boast of saving itself — the victory belongs to the Lord.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The three hundred take provisions and trumpets. The rest go to their tents. The army is reduced to a handful.

choices.label: Stand with the three hundred
choices.note: The story keeps its shape; the reduced band carries the promise forward.

choices.label: Rest at the spring
choices.note: A pause does not change the outcome. It only lets the player breathe.
